name: ehs-ai-grounding-eval: a benchmark for grounding of AI answers to safety-critical questions
description: A benchmark for measuring whether an AI system's answers to safety-critical technical questions are grounded in authoritative sources. Its items are built so that co-hyponym substitution, a semantically adjacent wrong answer, is plausible and dangerous. The repository contains a question corpus, a scoring harness, an adapter interface, a mock adapter and non-LLM baselines; it contains no experimental results for any language model.
